rows.description: A student who is repeatedly mocked in a group chat is told it is only ragging or fun; the receiver's real distress is dismissed by the label and deserves to be named plainly.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 23–26

rows.description: An adult hearing that a layoff is rightsizing or that pressure is motivation asks what actually happens to whom; plain words restore moral attention.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.subtopic: Moral disengagement: displacing and diffusing responsibility
rows.description: A child who joins in excluding a classmate says everyone else was doing it; when many share the act, no one feels fully responsible.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.subtopic: Moral disengagement: displacing and diffusing responsibility
rows.description: A teenager who spreads an embarrassing photo says the friend told them to send it; responsibility is placed on the authority or the group.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 18–22, 23–26

rows.subtopic: Moral disengagement: displacing and diffusing responsibility
rows.description: A student sees a group humiliate someone online and thinks that surely someone else will speak up; diffusion of responsibility makes each bystander silent, and one calm voice often breaks it.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 23–26

rows.subtopic: Moral disengagement: displacing and diffusing responsibility
rows.description: An employee ordered to hide a defect says they understand the instruction but remain accountable for their own actions, and raises it through proper channels; conscience does not transfer to a boss.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.description: A child from one street calls children from a rival street dirty or wild and refuses to play; labelling others as less than human makes rough treatment seem acceptable.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.subtype: Mocking a group as not real people [Actor]
rows.description: A teenager repeats jokes that call an outsider group stupid animals; stripping people of individual faces makes cruelty easier and empathy harder.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A migrant student is treated like a number or a burden and not addressed by name; feeling less than human is deeply painful, and staying connected to people who see them helps.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 23–26

rows.description: An adult who hears a group described with contempt asks about one person in it, or listens to a real story from someone there; individual faces bring back empathy.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22
